newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials lower at open, broad market firm.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials lower at open, broad market firm.

text.p: The Dow Industrials fell prey to profit-taking and a weak bond market in early trading on Monday to move lower after a strong rally on Friday. The overall market was firm.
The Dow Industrials was off three at 6,852. The Nasdaq Composite was u three at 1,360, while the S&P Index was up fractionally at 790
As Wall Street opened, the long bond was off 4/32 to yield 6.71 percent.
